successors.name: Majapahit
successors.text: Bali: Majapahit 'captured the Balinese capital of Bedulu in 1343' and gave authority over Bali to Arya Damar's younger brothers

ledger.x: 914: Sri Kesari Warmadewa raises the Belanjong pillar on Bali.
c. 1293: Bali is its own kingdom again. Singhasari fell to Jayakatwang in 1292 and Majapahit was founded in 1293; the Majapahit page finds a Balinese king at Bedulu in 1342.

wars.name: Singhasari expedition to Bali
wars.outcome: Bali integrated into Singhasari's realm; neither page says for how long, the Majapahit page finding a sovereign Balinese king in 1342.

wars.name: Majapahit conquest of Bali
wars.outcome: Majapahit wins after seven months and captures Bedulu in 1343; authority over Bali goes to Arya Damar's younger brothers.

certainty.note: The island's coast fixes the land, but the pages give no frontier and the extent beyond Bali (Lombok, Nusa Penida) is not described before the Gelgel period.
